blurb: Delbrook Golf Club offers 9 and 18 hole golf play with cart options, golf lessons for individuals and groups, junior golf programs, and season passes with various benefits. They also host golf tournaments and outings with professional services and catering. The club has reciprocal agreements with other local golf courses for pass holders.
extraNote: All prices include 5.5% Wisconsin Sales Tax · Season passes require a $1.00 per round user fee payable at time of play, non-refundable · April 1st through close (Fall)
